column1: # Files that testoperator_run_search.yml downloads before spiced starts, one per line:
# The spicepods in this directory read them as `file:data/<path>`. MS MARCO is read from local
# files, not over HTTP, because its Hugging Face Parquet has about 9,500 row groups of 0.2 MB. A
# Parquet read over HTTP makes about one range request per row group, and the Hub allows an
# anonymous client 500 `/api/` requests in 5 minutes. A load therefore never finished. Downloading
# a whole file is one request. See README.md, "Large datasets".
# here). The branch name is used, not a commit, because the Hub deletes the commits of that branch
